name: Pomodoro Study
description: Creates structured Pomodoro study sessions with topic breakdowns, timed work intervals, breaks, and review periods for learners. Uses the Pomodoro technique to produce a ready-to-follow session plan -- not an explanation of what the Pomodoro technique is. Use when a learner asks to use the Pomodoro technique for studying, structure a focused study session, or create a timed study plan with breaks. Do NOT use for general study planning over weeks (use `study-plan`), for spaced repetition scheduling (use `spaced-repetition`), or for time management beyond study sessions (not an education skill).
